title: Doubt
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Players of the phone game Rabbit Doubt meet offline and wake trapped in an abandoned psychiatric hospital, barcodes on their bodies and one of their group hanged. They must play a real version of the game and expose the 'wolf' among them as killings mount and secrets surface. The final twist reveals that the seemingly first victim, Rei, manipulated another girl through hypnosis to carry out revenge.
life_message: It suggests that trust is fragile and hidden guilt eventually surfaces; survival depends on seeing through lies.
